detail.zh: 按 PDL > 2字母 Country > 租户国家决定构建数据区（忽略顶栏环境）
detail.en: Resolves build geo via PDL > 2-letter Country > Tenant (ignores UI env)

detail.en: Deducts build Credits from CS env billing; stores chat in Maker geo

detail.en: No initial Dataverse; hosts CMR App, native Git repo & ms.config.json

detail.zh: 承载 Agent (bot / botcomponent) 与 Workflow；含 Dataverse 库时受 60+15 天清理约束
